descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S21 「医院 dashboard 和 p72 原型一致；养老院复用同样的设计」 Hospital dashboard matches the p72 prototype; Nursing Home reuses the same design

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 The Hospital dashboard matches the source-of-truth prototype (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html, DashboardScreen) in design and functionality（TFA-92598 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress
  • T2 The Nursing Home dashboard reuses the Hospital dashboard design (SOW Exhibit B)（TFA-92598 AC 2；TFA-92598 How it works 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92598 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (DashboardScreen) and the app's two dashboards

When Compare tiles, labels, colours, the All Patients list (name, room, pending task count, status badge), the back arrow and tap-to-open, side by side

Then Hospital matches the prototype; Nursing Home uses the same layout

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Human side-by-side review. Known differences to settle first: 'Done' vs 'Complete' (Q2); the prototype's In Progress / Done rule (Q1); the app's legend line and subtitle (Q7); 'Room' on Nursing Home rows (main shows the unit only)

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S21 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；辅助：DOC · 文档核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
